title: Geometric regularity over a separable algebraic extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be a separable algebraic field extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and let $R$ be a $k'$-algebra which is a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], regarded also as a $k$-algebra by restriction along $k\subseteq k'$. Then $R$ is geometrically regular over $k$ if and only if it is geometrically regular over $k'$; geometric regularity is the notion in [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

proof.text: For any finite purely inseparable L/k, apply separableTensor_purelyInseparable_isField to obtain a field structure and finiteness over k' on L' = k' tensor over k with L. This finite field extension is finitely generated, so isRegularRing_tensorProduct_of_isGeometricallyRegular applied to the assumed geometric regularity over k' gives regularity of L' tensor over k' with R. Tensor symmetry, cancelBaseChange, and tensor symmetry again give a ring equivalence to L tensor over k with R. Transport regularity with IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv and combine with the given Noetherianity. The finitely generated extension theorem avoids imposing any equality between the universes of k and k'.

proof.text: Let B = k' tensor over k with R, for a finite separable k'/k. The finitely generated field-extension regularity theorem gives regularity of B and hence its Noetherianity. For every finite purely inseparable L/k', the tower L/k is finite, hence finitely generated as a field. That theorem makes L tensor over k with R regular. Tensor cancellation identifies this with L tensor over k' with B, proving geometric regularity of B over k'. This is the private, fully proved finite_separable_ascent helper in the Lean module.

proof.text: The finite separable extension k'/k is etale by Algebra.Etale.of_finite_of_isSeparable. Base change and the tensor symmetry commRight make R -> B etale. The multiplication map phi : B -> R sends c tensor r to c*r. Its composite with R -> B is the identity, checked by lift_tmul and one_mul. Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars, the ring version of etale cancellation, therefore makes B -> R etale, hence smooth. Apply geometric regularity smooth ascent to phi and the previous step, completing finite_separable_ascent.

proof.text: Index by intermediate fields E of k'/k equipped with Module.Finite k E. This type is nonempty because it contains the bottom field. A common upper bound for E and F is their supremum, finite by IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup. Each x in k' lies in k(x), finite by IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional applied to Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral k x. Thus the underlying subfields form a directed cover of k'. Separability and compatible algebra structures restrict to each E by the existing intermediate-field instances. Apply finite_separable_ascent at each E, then geometricallyRegular_of_directed_subfields to conclude.
